{{Otheruses|Level 2}}
The '''Environment shield level 2''' was an aftermarket modification of the type of [[Droid shield|shielding]] typically found on deep-core [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The shield provided broad spectrum protection against an array of environmental effects. Unfortunately, the power drain during its use was significant, therefore, the units needed to be replaced regularly.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
